status: prospective full-tree resource policy; independent review and parent authorization required before use
source_closure: ALL tracked blob paths from exact target Git tree; no prefix or recursive-JSON selection; no pruning or inode/OID deduplication
resource_bound: Exact closed path/mode/Git blob/size set and total replaces arbitrary capacity ceiling only in distinct future v5 context. V4 and its 750MiB failure remain unchanged. Reject any changed count/size/path/mode/blob/parents/tree.
regular_file_read: One MiB binary blocks compute SHA256 and Git SHA1 initialized with blob length header; compare actual byte count, mode and Git blob per path. Never read_bytes() whole source file. Reject special files and unexpected symlinks.
symlink_rule: Only enumerated mode120000 path accepted; os.readlink payload encoded os.fsencode, size and Git blob/SHA256 checked; never open/follow target. Ancestor symlinks rejected for every regular file.
case_alias_rule: Both logical names independently included and verified against exact same Git identity, even on case-insensitive physical filesystem. No file-count or byte-total deduction.
race_rule: Before/after lstat file identity (dev,inode,mode,size,mtime_ns,ctime_ns) must agree during streamed read; exact byte count/Git hash required. Wrapper reruns full set pre/post package.
preserved_v4_guards: Exact physical copied-root membership including empty directories, modes, Git identities and SHA256; untracked members rejected
Exact qualified asset directory membership, modes, hashes
Normal dataset grant archives, curated index records and ignored Lade witness guards
Exact both-parent branch delta and deleted-path absence
Exact commit, ordered parents, plan and helper identity
